rate_limits: Regular GovInfo API keys: 36,000 requests/hour (primary limit), 1,200/minute, and 40/second; hourly usage is tracked on a rolling basis. DEMO_KEY has lower limits.
resolution_notes: rate_limits: ORIGINAL is incorrect. GPO's current GovInfo API documentation specifies GovInfo-specific defaults of 36,000/hour, 1,200/minute, and 40/second, while stating DEMO_KEY is lower: https://github.com/usgpo/api/blob/main/README.md. The generic 1,000/hour data.gov limit may vary by service and therefore does not override GovInfo's published service-specific limits: https://api.data.gov/docs/developer-manual/
